name: Honoguraki Toki no Hate Yori
source:
It was the forbidden summer. 

Working as a detective's assistant, Gojou Kouichi returns to his hometown island at the request of a client searching for a friend who has gone missing. His little sister who came to welcome him at the harbor, his parents’ guesthouse and the state of the town all appear to be unchanged. However, rumours of a strange creature are heard within the island, and one night a doubtful Kouichi is assaulted by a monster. Inui Komako, a lone girl who seeks to destroy it unbeknownst to the villagers, saves him from the clutches of death with blade in hand. Kouichi was certain that he saw it. He saw the monster appearing from obscurity, but also the realm spreading out from the ends of darkness. It was a sight that humans must never lay eyes on.

The forbidden domain.

[Translated from [url=http://www.moon-stone.jp/product/ms24/story.html]Official Site[/url]; adjusted with personal description]
translation:
那是禁忌的夏天。

作为一名侦探助理，五条浩一应一位寻找失踪朋友的客户的要求返回家乡岛屿。到港口迎接他的妹妹、父母的宾馆以及小镇的状况似乎都没有改变。然而，岛上传来了有关奇怪生物的传言，一天晚上，心存疑虑的光一遭到了怪物的袭击。孤独的女孩干驹子试图在村民们不知情的情况下摧毁它，并用手中的刀片将他从死亡的魔掌中拯救出来。康一确信自己看到了。他看到了从朦胧中出现的怪物，也看到了从黑暗尽头蔓延开来的领域。这是人类绝不能看到的景象。

禁域。

[翻译自[url=http://www.moon-stone.jp/product/ms24/story.html]官方网站[/url]；根据个人描述进行调整]
